name: self
language: JavaScript/TypeScript (neuraldoc-app itself, docs inside the repository)
notes: neuraldoc's own repository as a user would import it by GitHub URL (tracked files plus uncommitted work, no submodules), with ten planted mismatches of ten different kinds: five where the documentation was edited to a wrong statement, five where the code changed and the documentation stayed. Each item names the files where a correct finding must quote the stale statement (quote) or add the missing name (added). Nothing here is read by the product. With --history the documentation mutations are part of the tagged release and every code mutation comes as a commit after it (field commit), as in a repository imported by URL.
